title: gymnopteris subcordata
intro: Gymnopteris subcordata, commonly known as Indian Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, as well as potential uses in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gymnopteris subcordata include anti-anxiety, anti-stress, and anti-arthritic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, limited research is available on the specific bioactive constituents of this plant, and further studies are needed to confirm its full potential.
